items.distractor_fact: Sebuah agensi cuaca serantau lain merekodkan bacaan suhu setinggi {D}°C pada masa yang sama.
items.gloss_en: A different regional weather agency recorded a temperature reading of D°C at the same time.
items.entity_note: an organisation (a regional weather agency), not a place like the first distractor's neighbouring city

items.gloss_en: On the stock exchange of a neighbouring country, the share price of a related company closed at a level of D that day.
items.entity_note: a place (a foreign stock exchange), not an organisation like the first distractor's other company

items.distractor_fact: Seorang jurutera yang menyelia sebuah takungan air berlainan mencatatkan paras air pada bacaan {D} meter pada masa yang sama.
items.gloss_en: An engineer supervising a different water reservoir recorded the water level at a reading of D meters at the same time.
items.entity_note: a person (an engineer), not a place like the first distractor's other dam

items.distractor_fact: Seorang juruterbang belon udara panas berada pada ketinggian {D} meter pada masa yang sama di kawasan lain.
items.gloss_en: A hot-air balloon pilot was at an altitude of D meters at the same time in a different area.
items.entity_note: a person (a balloon pilot), not an instrument like the first distractor's other drone

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah kedai runcit di pasar yang sama menyimpan wang tunai dalam tilnya sebanyak {D} pada awal minggu itu.
items.gloss_en: A grocery shop in the same market kept cash in its till amounting to D at the start of that week.
items.entity_note: an organisation (a shop), not a person like the first distractor's other trader

items.distractor_fact: Seorang guru di sekolah itu menyimpan wang tabungan peribadinya sebanyak {D} pada bulan yang sama.
items.gloss_en: A teacher at that school kept personal savings amounting to D in the same month.
items.entity_note: a person (a teacher), not an organisation like the first distractor's other school cooperative

items.distractor_fact: Seorang peniaga persendirian berdekatan mengumpul wang jualan sebanyak {D} sepanjang hari yang sama.
items.gloss_en: A nearby independent vendor collected sales money amounting to D during that same day.
items.entity_note: a person (an independent vendor), not an organisation like the first distractor's other school canteen

items.distractor_fact: Pemilik sebuah kenderaan lain menambah nilai tunai sebanyak {D} untuk mengisi minyak pada bulan yang sama.
items.gloss_en: The owner of a different vehicle topped up cash value amounting to D for refuelling in the same month.
items.entity_note: a person (a vehicle owner), not an instrument like the first distractor's other fuel card

items.distractor_fact: Pada edisi liga musim sebelumnya, jumlah jaringan gol yang direkodkan keseluruhannya berjumlah {D}.
items.gloss_en: In the previous season's league edition, the total goals recorded overall amounted to D.
items.entity_note: a series (a past league edition), not an organisation like the first distractor's other football team

items.distractor_fact: Seorang usahawan persendirian yang menjalankan perniagaan kecilnya sendiri memperoleh pendapatan sebanyak {D} pada bulan tersebut.
items.gloss_en: An independent entrepreneur running their own small business earned income amounting to D that month.
items.entity_note: a person (a sole entrepreneur), not an organisation like the first distractor's other company

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah koperasi pertanian di daerah itu mengumpul hasil tuaian sebanyak {D} kilogram pada musim yang sama.
items.gloss_en: An agricultural cooperative in that district collected a harvest yield amounting to D kilograms in the same season.
items.entity_note: an organisation (an agricultural cooperative), not a person like the first distractor's other farmer

items.distractor_fact: Pada suku tahun sebelumnya, industri berkaitan itu secara keseluruhan menghasilkan sebanyak {D} unit barangan sebenar, mengikut sasaran suku tahun tersebut yang tidak dinyatakan di sini.
items.gloss_en: In the previous quarter, the related industry as a whole produced an actual count of D units of goods, against that quarter's target, not stated here.
items.entity_note: a series (a previous quarter's industry-wide figure with its own unstated target), not an organisation like the first distractor's other factory

items.distractor_fact: Pada kejohanan golf yang berlainan tahun sebelumnya, seorang pemain lain mencatatkan sebanyak {D} pukulan bagi pusingannya, pada padang dengan par sendiri yang tidak dinyatakan di sini.
items.gloss_en: At a different golf tournament the previous year, another player recorded a count of D strokes for their round, on a course with its own par, not stated here.
items.entity_note: a series (a past tournament edition with its own unstated par), not a person like the first distractor's other golfer on another course

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah syarikat bas yang mengendalikan laluan berlainan tiba pada minit ke-{D} selepas jam rujukan jadualnya sendiri.
items.gloss_en: A bus company operating a different route arrived at minute D after its own timetable's reference hour mark.
items.entity_note: an organisation (a bus company), not an instrument like the first distractor's other train

items.distractor_fact: Sebuah agensi pemetaan kerajaan yang berlainan mencatatkan ketinggian sebuah tapak lain pada bacaan {D} meter, menggunakan datum rujukannya sendiri.
items.gloss_en: A different government mapping agency recorded a different site's elevation at a reading of D meters, using its own reference datum.
items.entity_note: an organisation (a government mapping agency), not a person like the first distractor's other surveyor

items.gloss_en: A different school recorded that form level's average student score amounting to D marks in a different standardised exam.
items.entity_note: an organisation (a different school's average score), not a person like the first distractor's third student

items.gloss_en: A different construction company is building a different tower project with a designed height amounting to D meters.
items.entity_note: an organisation (a construction company), not a place like the first distractor's other tower in a different city

items.gloss_en: A running club organised a different race event and recorded its participants' average time amounting to D seconds.
